text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release/2026-03-15_ha-routing -> canary group C1. Targets: latency <120ms p95, 5xx <0.5%. Rolling 10%.

deploy-bot: Metrics feed: canary C1 5xx_rate=6.8% (window=1m) — abort_threshold=2.0% triggered. Error samples attached.

alex-oncall: @sam-sre paging — canary 5xx spike on release roll. getting page now.

sam-sre: on it — looking at canary logs. anyone still running traffic to C1?

mira-release: I see rollout controller still directing 10% to C1. nothing else changed in deploy config besides the feature flag for "ha-routing".

raj-runtime: grabbing runtime logs, tails show a bunch of 502/gateway errors from transformer pool OOMs. snippet:

```
2026-03-15T11:02:43Z ERROR request.cpp:412 client 10.8.2.14 status=502 backend_err=kv-cache-miss, worker=7
2026-03-15T11:02:44Z WARN model-serving: worker 7 OOM while allocating kv_cache 2.3GB
2026-03-15T11:02:44Z INFO autoscaler: no spare workers, queue_len=32
```

zoe-support: any customer impact yet? cs dashboard shows a few errors surfaced in app logs but no major tickets yet. one enterprise customer (acme-corp) saw degraded response in webhook processing.

sam-sre: OK abort criteria met per runbook: canary 5xx > 2% for 2 consecutive 1m windows. Initiating canary abort.

alex-oncall: Executing abort now — disabling routing to canary and enabling fallback to baseline. Command: `/rollout abort release/2026-03-15_ha-routing --canary C1`

deploy-bot: Received abort command from alex-oncall. Starting rollback sequence. 

incident-bot: Paging notes: incident created INC-2026-0315-17, priority=P2, owner=alex-oncall. Notify: #product, #support.

mira-release: Reverting feature-flag as safety too — flipping ff:ha-routing -> off for all environments. Doing via feature-store.

raj-runtime: After abort, rollback applied. Confirming traffic now on baseline. But we still see backlog in workers; queue drain in progress. Current 5xx rate dropping: 5xx_rate=1.9% (window=30s).

sam-sre: Good. Start pod/node remediation: marking problematic nodes cordon+drain. Suspect memory regression on the new model variant.

alex-oncall: @zoe-support please draft a short customer message: "We detected a canary issue during a release and rolled back; some requests experienced errors briefly. We're investigating and will update."

zoe-support: Draft posted to #support-daily. I'll also ping acme-corp point of contact and offer a postmortem once we confirm root cause.

mira-release: Reproducer steps: canary uses new kv-cache tuning + quantized kernel. suspect kv-cache size config increased and caused OOM under short load bursts. saving canary config for analysis.

raj-runtime: I'm uploading flame/log bundles: s3://redwood-ops/incident/1755001234/logs.tar.gz. Core dump from worker-7 included.

sam-sre: temp mitigation checklist: 1) rollback (done) 2) disable ff (done) 3) cordon nodes (in progress) 4) increase autoscaler buffer for baseline pools (w/ caution)

alex-oncall: How long to drain queue and confirm full recovery?

raj-runtime: draining ETA ~3-5m. p95 latency returning to baseline 98ms. 5xx stabilizing at 0.2%.

incident-bot: Update INC-2026-0315-17: status=mitigated, mitigation=rollback+ff-kill, sla-impact=partial for ~6m, customers_notified=yes.

sam-sre: I'll own postmortem. initial hypothesis: regressed memory pattern in quantized kernel + kv-cache resizing. Need to run canary in isolated pool and reproduce with load tests.

mira-release: Agreed. I'll hold the release until postmortem and patch. Planning an A/B with smaller cache delta and memory limits.

alex-oncall: Oncall handoff in 30m — @sam-sre can you pick up monitoring until then? I'll leave notes on the incident thread and hand off to @mira-release for next steps.

sam-sre: I got it. Monitoring and alarms active. Will update if any regressions show.

alex-oncall: Thanks everyone — closing live mitigation. Follow-ups: postmortem, config diff, canary gating test and stricter abort threshold for memory-related errors. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary traffic disabled for release/2026-03-15_ha-routing. Release paused.

mira-release: Filing PR with toggled kv-cache default and a canary test script. Link: https://git.redwood/repo/ha-routing/pull/472

sam-sre: Incident workspace created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0315-17 — attaching logs and timeline.

zoe-support: Customer outreach logged. We'll coordinate postmortem messaging once root cause confirmed.

incident-bot: Final note: incident closed to active mitigation at 1755001654. Postmortem due in 72h.
